# Brannen circulant is the forced C3-covariant record-preserving generation form

**Claim type:** bounded_theorem

## Claim
On the C3[111] generation 3-space, a local Hermitian generator commuting with the [111] 3-fold
rotation `C`, namely `[H,C]=0`, is forced by the cubic Lattice symmetry to have the circulant form
`H = a I + b C + conj(b) C^T`. This is the Brannen form. It has exactly three real couplings,
written as `(a, |b|, delta)`, and the induced dynamics is record-forming because it commutes with the
einselected pointer `S = C + C^2`. In this theorem, the couplings (a, |b|, delta) are the supplied sector dial.

## Derivation
The runner builds the real 9-dimensional Hermitian basis and computes the commutator map
`H -> [H,C]` by an exact rank/nullspace calculation on that basis. The nullity is required to be exactly
`3`. If the nullity were `9`, C3 covariance would not force the form; if it were `1`, it would over-force
the sector to scalars. The runner then reconstructs every computed commuting Hermitian basis vector,
and general real combinations of them, as `a I + b C + conj(b) C^T`. This establishes the commutant as
the circulant algebra, not merely as an abstract 3-real-dimensional space.

Locality on the generation 3-cycle supplies the range-`<=1` displacement operators `{I, C, C^2}`. Their
span is the C3-covariant local algebra, and Hermiticity restricts the coefficients to
`a in R` and paired coefficients `b, conj(b)`, giving the Brannen form. Record-preservation is then
non-demolition for the two-sector pointer because every Brannen-form `H` commutes with
`S = C + C^2`, whose spectrum is `{2, -1, -1}`. This is the generation-space analog of the backticked
gauge mechanism `DYNAMICS_FORM_FROM_RECORD_PRESERVATION_GAUGE_INVARIANT_LOCAL_CLASS_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-06-05`.

## Significance
This upgrades the Brannen circulant from an explicit bounded classification premise to the forced
record-preserving C3-covariant generation form. The only remaining freedom is the three real couplings:
`a`, `|b|`, and `delta`. Equivalently, the Brannen FORM is forced; the couplings are the dial.

## Boundary
The FORM is forced by the supplied C3[111] lattice-symmetry input plus locality and Hermiticity. The
COUPLINGS `(a, |b|, delta)` are not forced. This note does NOT derive delta, does NOT force r=1/2, and
does not supply the within-sector measure. The open next stage is the relaxation or coupling-determination
target that would explain which sector dial values are selected. The [111]-C3-from-cubic-lattice input
and the einselected pointer input are assumed here.
